answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. This economic trellis ensures that identity creation remains prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to flood the lagoon of the network must sacrifice capital, essentially pruning their lotus of influence to zero. The cost of such an attack is directly proportional to the total burned supply, making large-scale identity fabrication mathematically irrational for malicious nodes.
